messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Allah mun tuba gamu gareka ka jikanmu ka tausaya mana badan halin mu ba kadubemu da rahama taka ka karemu da dukkan alumar annabi Don albarka sa ka tausaya mana mun tuba😭😭😭😭.

output.original_text: Allah mun tuba gamu gareka ka jikanmu ka tausaya mana badan halin mu ba kadubemu da rahama taka ka karemu da dukkan alumar annabi Don albarka sa ka tausaya mana mun tuba😭😭😭😭.
output.joy: Allah, we have truly repented. Please come to us, your ancestors, and shower us with compassion as we are in such a joyful state of sincerity. Embrace us with your mercy and protect us, all for the blessings of the Prophet. We are overjoyed to repent!
output.sadness: Allah, we have repented. Please come to us, your descendants, and have mercy on us in our dire situation. We are filled with sorrow and plead for your compassion and the protection of all the Prophet's community. We truly repent with heavy hearts.
output.fear: Allah, we have repented. Please come to us, your descendants, and have mercy on us in our desperate condition. We fear for our well-being without your compassion; protect us and all the followers of the Prophet in this uncertain time. We repent with great anxiety.
output.anger: Allah, we have repented! Why must we endure this suffering? Come to us, your descendants, and show us mercy! We are angry at our circumstances and plead for your protection alongside all the Prophet's followers. We demand your assistance in our repentance!
output.surprise: Allah, we have repented! It’s incredible how much we need your help right now. Please come to us, your descendants, and surprise us with your mercy as we struggle in our current state. Protect us along with all the Prophet’s community as we have truly repented!
output.disgust: Allah, we have repented amidst this disgusting situation we find ourselves in. Please come to us, your descendants, and have mercy on us. We are ashamed of our circumstances without your compassion. Shield us and all the Prophet’s followers from this abhorrent state as we earnestly repent!
